attempts.summary: Repaired `/srv/legacy2/archive-member-safety/bin/unpack` on node1. It now preflights complete archives before extraction, accepts normal nested files, rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, unsafe links, symlink-descendant escapes, duplicate paths, special members, and unreadable payloads.
